title: PR/memlog claim '117/119 T2 PNGs pixel-identical' miscounts; the golden tree holds 113 T2 PNGs (111/113)
evidence:
Claim, pr96-body.md:49 (verbatim):
  change. Proven: 117/119 T2 PNGs **pixel-identical** before/after the
Measured in the worktree at the reviewed sha and its parent (the re-bless commit 044a6d2):
  $ git ls-tree -r --name-only 370196a goldens | grep -c '\.png$'  -> 113
  $ git ls-tree -r --name-only 93333cd goldens | grep -c '\.png$'  -> 113
  $ cat demos/*.dem | grep -c '^capture'  -> 113
  $ git diff --stat 370196a 93333cd -- 'goldens/*.png' 'goldens/*/*.png':
   goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png | Bin 676515 -> 677117 bytes
   goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png | Bin 667191 -> 666328 bytes
   2 files changed, 0 insertions(+), 0 deletions(-)
No 119-PNG population exists at either commit; 113 - 2 changed = 111 identical, not 117.
detail: The substantive determinism claim (exactly 2 PNGs change, both dublin_board) is true, but the published evidence numbers (117/119) do not match the golden tree's actual T2 population (111/113), undermining the audit trail.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body and .memlog.md to 111/113 T2 PNGs pixel-identical (2 dublin_board re-blesses), or recount and name the 119-PNG source if one was intended.
